title: kith-jmap: no test that a panicking JMAP handler returns serverFail
description: dispatch_one wraps every handler call in tokio::task::spawn to catch panics (lines 480-488 peer, 499-507 owner). The catch path returns serverFail. No test exercises this path — a regression in the spawn/catch logic would go undetected. Add a PanicHandler test fixture and a test that it produces serverFail not a task panic.
